spans.s:
प्रथ् 1. प्रथ्, cl. 1. P. A. प्रथति, -ते,
पप्राथ, पप्रथे, प्रथिष्यते, अ-
प्रथिष्ट, प्रथितुम्, (P.) to spread, extend
(trans.), prolong (Ved.); (P. A.) to spread, stretch,
extend (intrans.); (A.) to become larger or wider,
increase; to be spread abroad (said of fame, of a
name, of a speech or rumour); to become well
known, become famous or celebrated; to come to
light, appear, arise; to occur (to the mind): Caus.
P. A. प्रथयति, -ते, -यितुम्, Aor. अपप्रथत्, to
spread, stretch, extend (trans.); to increase, augment,
enhance, aggrandize; to spread abroad, proclaim,
celebrate; to bring to light; to unfold, disclose, reveal,
display, show, manifest, evince, to shine upon, give
light to (with acc., Ṛg-veda

); (A.) to
stretch, extend, increase (intrans., Ved.).

प्रथ् 2. प्रथ् or पृथ्, cl. 10. P. प्राथ-
यति or पर्थयति, -यितुम्, to throw,
cast; to extend.

प्रथ, अस्, m. (said to be the) N. of the author
[]
of Ṛg-veda

; (आ), f. spreading out; fame,
celebrity, notoriety (e. g. पृथु-प्रथ, far-famed).
—प्रथापह (˚था-अप्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, destroying
fame, destructive to celebrity.

प्रथन, अस्, m. the plant Phaseolus Mungo
[cf. प्र-घन]; (अम्), n. spreading, extension;
scattering; throwing, projecting; a place where any-
thing is spread; displaying, showing; celebrating.

1. प्रथयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, spreading out, ex-
tending; bringing to light, displaying, making mani-
fest; seeing, beholding.
2. प्राथयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, throwing, casting.

प्रथयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who spreads or
extends; one who proclaims, a proclaimer.

प्रथयितृ प्रथयितृ, प्रथस्, &c. See
under rt. 1. प्रथ्.

प्रथस्, अस्, n., Ved. width, extension.
—प्र-
थस्-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. wide, spacious.

प्रथित, अस्, आ, अम्, stretched, spread; scattered;
extended, increased; made known, published, openly
announced, declared; famed, famous, celebrated, re-
nowned; disclosed, shown, manifested, evinced; in-
tent upon, engaged in, occupied by, devoted to;
(अस्), m., N. of one of the sons of Manu Svārociṣa.
—प्रथित-त्व, अम्, n. the being known or famous,
celebrity.
—प्रथित-विदिशा-लक्षण, अस्, आ, अम्,
renowned under the title of Vidiśā.
—प्रथितानुराग
(˚त-अन्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, manifesting or evincing affection.
प्रथिति, इस्, f. celebrity, notoriety.

प्रथिमन्, आ, m. extension, width, breadth,
greatness, magnitude.

प्रथिमिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having size or magnitude,
large, great; (इनी), f., see Scholiast on Pāṇ.

प्रथिवी, f. the earth; (probably an incorrect
form for पृथिवी.)

प्रथिष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम् (superl. of पृथु),
broadest, widest, largest, very large or great, most
extended.

प्रथीयस्, आन्, असी, अस् (compar. of पृथु),
larger, broader, wider, more extended, very large.

प्रथु, उस्, उस्, उ, = पृथु, wide, wide spread;
an epithet of Viṣṇu.

प्रथुक, अस्, m. = पृथुक, the young of any
animal.

प्रथम प्रथम, अस्, आ, अम् (connected with
1. प्र; said to be fr. rt. 1. प्रथ्, Uṇādi-s.

;
declined as a pronominal in Atharva-veda

;
according to Pāṇ.

, the declension follows
शिव except in the nom. pl. m. which may option-
ally be प्रथमे or प्रथमास्), foremost, first,
the first in a series (= आदि, पूर्व); earliest, most
ancient, primary, original; preceding, previous, prior,
earlier, former (sometimes translatable adverbially,
e. g. प्रथमो निवृत्तः, returned first; प्रथमे
प्रेषिता दूताः, messengers sent previously); first,
chief, principal, most excellent, most eminent or
distinguished, matchless, incomparable; (अस्), m.,
scil. वर्ण, the first consonant of a Varga, a hard
letter (= वर्ग-प्˚); scil. पुरुष, the first (= in
European grammars the third) person, a termination
of the first (or according to European grammars
third) person; scil. स्वर, the first tone (in gram-
mar); (आ), f., scil. विभक्ति, the first or nominative
case, a termination of the first or nominative case;
(ए), f. du., scil. विभक्ती, the first two cases, the
terminations of the first two cases; (अम्), ind. first,
firstly, at first, for the first time (opposed to चर-
मम्); just, newly, recently; at once, immediately;
before (with gen., e. g. शक्तेः प्रथमम्, before
strength, i. e. before the forces were ready, Raghu-v.
IV. 24

); (आत्), ind. firstly, for the first time; प्र-
थमम् — अनन्तरम्, first — afterwards; प्रथ-
मम् — ततस्, first — next; प्रथमम् — पश्चात्,
first — afterwards; [cf. Gr. πρῶ-το-ς; Lat. primus;
Goth. fru-ma; Lith. pī1r-ma-s.]
—प्रथम-क-
थित, अस्, आ, अम्, aforesaid, before-mentioned,
afore-mentioned.
—प्रथम-कल्प, अस्, m. a
primary or principal rule.
—प्रथम-कल्पित,
[]
अस्, आ, अम्, placed first, first in rank or importance,
having precedence.
—प्रथम-कुसुम, अस् or
अम्, m. or n. (?), white marjoram.
—प्रथम-
गर्भ, अस्, m., Ved. first pregnancy or con-
finement; a first litter; (अस्, आ, अम्), pregnant
for the first time.
—प्रथम-ग्रन्थ, अस्, m.,
N. of a poem by Jagaj-jīvana-dāsa.
—प्रथम-
च्छद्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. covering first, (Sāy. = प्रथ-
मम् आच्छादयितृ); typical, figurative.
—प्र-
थम-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, or प्रथम-जा, आस्, आस्, अम्,
firstborn, a firstling; original, primary; being the
issue of the first (i. e. first-mentioned marriage).
—प्रथम-जात, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. firstborn.
—प्रथम-तस्, ind. first, at first, firstly, in the
first place; previously; forthwith, straightway, im-
mediately; before, in preference to (with gen.).
—प्रथम-दर्शन, अम्, n. first sight; (ए), ind.
at first sight.
—प्रथम-दिवस, अस्, m. a first
day, principal day.
—प्रथम-दुग्ध, अस्, आ,
अम्, Ved. just milked.
—प्रथम-परिगृहीत,
अस्, आ, अम्, formerly married.
—प्रथम-पुरुष,
अस्, m. the first (= in European grammars the third)
person in the verb, a termination of the first (or ac-
cording to European grammars third) person.
—प्र-
थम-भाज्, क्, क्, क्, Ved. one to whom the first
share is due; (Sāy. = उत्पत्ति-काल एव विभक्तृ,
dividing or distinguishing beings at the time of crea-
tion.)
—प्रथम-मङ्गल, अस्, आ, अम्, highly
auspicious.
—प्रथम-यज्ञ, अस्, m., Ved. the first
sacrifice.
—प्रथम-यौवन, अम्, n. early youth,
early age.
—प्रथम-रात्र, अस्, m., Ved. the
beginning of night.
—प्रथम-वयस्, अस्, n.
earliest age, youth.
—प्रथम-वयसिन्, ई, इनी, इ,
Ved. being in early youth, young.
—प्रथम-
वास्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. worn formerly (as a gar-
ment).
—प्रथम-वित्ता, f., Ved. a first wife.
—प्रथम-विरह, अस्, m. first separation; (ए),
ind. immediately after separation.
—प्रथम-
वृत्तान्त, अस्, m. former circumstances, earlier his-
tory, antecedents.
—प्रथम-वैयाकरण, अस्,
m. a beginner in grammar; a distinguished or first-
rate grammarian.
—प्रथम-श्रवस्, आस्, आस्, अस्,
Ved. having a distinguished reputation; (Sāy. =
अतिशयितं धनं यशो वा यस्य.)
—प्रथम-
सङ्गम, अस्, m., N. of a man.
—प्रथम-सा-
हस, अस्, m. the first or lowest degree of punishment
or fine.
—प्रथम-सुकृत, अम्, n. a former
service or kindness.
—प्रथम-स्थान, अम्, n.,
Ved. the first or lowest scale (in pronunciation, low
but audible).
—प्रथम-स्वर, अम्, n., N. of a
Sāman.
—प्रथमागामिन् (˚म-आग्˚), ई, इनी, इ,
occurring first, first mentioned.
—प्रथमादेश
(˚म-आद्˚), अस्, m. placing (a word) at the beginning
of a sentence.
—प्रथमाभितप्त (˚म-अभ्˚),
अस्, आ, अम्, first scorched or scalded (with tears).
—प्रथमार्ध (˚म-अर्˚), अस् or अम्, m. or
n. (?), the first half.
—प्रथमावर-त्व (˚म-
अव्˚), अम्, n. the being the first and the last.
—प्र-
थमास्तमित (˚म-अस्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. just set
(said of the sun).
—प्रथमेतर (˚म-इत्˚), अस्,
आ, अम्, ‘other than first,’ the second.
—प्रथमोत्-
पन्न (˚म-उत्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, produced first, first-
born.
—प्रथमोदित (˚म-उद्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, first
uttered, uttered previously.
प्रथमक, अस्, आ, अम्, first, foremost.

प्राथमिक प्राथमिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-
थम), belonging or relating to the first, primary,
first, initial, initiative, prior, previous; happening or
occurring for the first time.

प्राथमकल्पिक, अस्, m. (fr. प्रथम +
कल्प), one who has just commenced the perusal
of the Vedas, a student; a term applied to a Yogi
just commencing his course.

प्राथम्य, अम्, n. the being first, priority, pre-
cedence.
